questions.question: 01. 다음 우리말에 맞도록 대화[담화]를 바르게 영작하시오. 문장 전체를 쓰시오. Watch and Talk A-1.
answers:
B: Excuse me, how can I get to the Star Stadium?
G: You can get there by subway. Take line 4, the green line, and get off at Hangang Station.
B: Line 4 and Hangang Station. Got it. How long will it take?
G: A little more than 30 minutes.
questions.explainKo: 정답: B: Excuse me, how can I get to the Star Stadium?

questions.question: 02. 다음 우리말에 맞도록 대화[담화]를 바르게 영작하시오. 문장 전체를 쓰시오. Watch and Talk A-2.
answers:
B: I'm sorry, but how can I get to the Sky Cinema?
G: It's not far, but it's a little difficult to find. Why don't you take a taxi?
B: OK. How long will it take?
G: By taxi? About 20 minutes.
questions.explainKo: 정답: B: I'm sorry, but how can I get to the Sky Cinema?

questions.question: 03. 다음 우리말에 맞도록 대화[담화]를 바르게 영작하시오. 문장 전체를 쓰시오. Watch and Talk A-3.
answers:
G: Do you need help?
B: Yes. How can I get to the Dream Shopping Mall from here? Can I walk?
G: You can, but it's a little far. Why don't you go by bus? Take bus No. 12.
B: OK. How long will it take by bus?
G: Not very long. It'll take less than 10 minutes.
questions.explainKo: 정답: G: Do you need help?

questions.question: 04. 다음 우리말에 맞도록 대화[담화]를 바르게 영작하시오. 문장 전체를 쓰시오. Watch and Talk A-4.
answers:
B: Excuse me. I'm going to the National Art Museum. What's the best way to get there?
G: You can walk. Go straight for about 500 meters and turn left. It'll be on your right.
B: I see. How long will it take?
G: Only about 15 minutes.
B: Really? Thanks.

questions.question: 05. 다음 우리말에 맞도록 대화[담화]를 바르게 영작하시오. 문장 전체를 쓰시오. Watch and Talk C.
answers:
B: Somi, I need help. What's the best way to get to Sebit Park from here?
G: Sebit Park? Well, you can get there by bus or by subway, but the subway is better.
B: OK. Which line should I take?
G: Take line 3, and get off at Sebit Station.
B: Line 3 and get off at Sebit Station. How long will it take?
G: It'll take about 40 minutes.
B: Is it that far?
G: Yes. Anyway, why are you going to Sebit Park, Liam?
B: Oh, there is an art fair this Saturday. You can come with me if you want.
G: Really? I'm free this Saturday. Let's go together.
B: Perfect. Let's meet here at 10.
questions.explainKo: 정답: B: Somi, I need help.

questions.question: 06. 다음 우리말에 맞도록 대화[담화]를 바르게 영작하시오. 문장 전체를 쓰시오. Speak Up.
answers: I'll explain how you can get to the City Library from the school. The best way to get there is to take the bus. You can take bus No. 2 or 5, and it'll only take about 10 minutes.

questions.question: 07. 다음 우리말에 맞도록 대화[담화]를 바르게 영작하시오. 문장 전체를 쓰시오. Review 1.

G: Excuse me, how can I get to the Dream Zoo?
B: You can take the subway.
G: I see. How long will it take?
B: I think it'll take about 30 minutes.

questions.question: 08. 다음 우리말에 맞도록 대화[담화]를 바르게 영작하시오. 문장 전체를 쓰시오. Review 2.

B: Excuse me, how can I get to Seoul Museum from here?
G: Seoul Museum? You can get there by bus or by subway.
B: Which is faster, the bus or the subway?
G: Hmm, I think the bus is faster.
B: Really? Then, I'll take the bus.
